notes.title: Cats Away: Meet the Captains
notes.content:
[p]A nautical adventure with adorable talking cats and exciting sea battles, [b][i]Cats Away[/i][/b] brings real-time strategy to the high seas—and we’d like to introduce you to the ladies who take turns as captain of your ship.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Lilia Spelle[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680879/d87751d65c7be4888c3da98b769f72ef5d14af6b.png"][/img]A magician who specializes in wind magic, Lilia is the oldest and most level-headed of the three sisters. She’s reliable, prim and proper, but she has a little bit of a sadistic streak at times. Her pet cat Erin is cunning, clever and extremely loyal. When Lilia is serving as your ship’s captain, your crew will regain HP more quickly.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Kanna Bleuprinte[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680879/293aac6d70e04ba02e408c7a0abe3a0ae69285e6.png"][/img]Kanna is a mechanical genius who can work on anything from hulls to spirit furnaces. But she can be impulsive and occasionally reckless; her motto is "As long as it moves, it's fine." Her pet cat Sanders is a bit lazy, but works hard when he needs to. When you choose Kanna as the captain, your ship’s repairs and weapon loadouts will go faster.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Alicia Aime[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680879/815e44d304a7e651431fbccc9575952b96c166b3.png"][/img]Youngest of the sisters, Alicia is an eagle-eyed sharpshooter and weapons expert. But she gets nervous easily, worries constantly and can't seem to hide her frequent panic. Her pet cat is Shion, a responsible fellow for whom every day is “Talk Like a Pirate” day. With Alicia as captain, the entire crew's accuracy will increase.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680879/7e0e41af656ccc4369016afeeaeda3e59c14fca5.png"][/img]Depending on the conditions of a particular battle, you may find yourself gaining an advantage by allowing one specific sister to take over as captain—in addition to the benefits mentioned above, the commands available during a battle will also change depending on which captain is at the helm. But why don’t these sisters have the same last name? And what challenges lie ahead? You’ll have to play [b][i]Cats Away[/i][/b] to find out![/p]

notes.title: Cats Away Available Now!
notes.content: [p]Calling all feline friends![/p][p][/p][p]Nicalis celebrates National Kitten Day today with the release of [i][b]Cats Away[/b][/i]![/p][p][/p][p]A real-time strategy game with extensive visual-novel dialogue, [i][b]Cats Away[/b][/i] features adventurous girls, adorable talking cats and exciting sea battles. By giving orders to an ever-expanding crew of cat sailors, players can attempt to save the world from the reawakening of an ancient evil.[/p][p][/p][p]Developed by Studio Saizensen with Success Corp., [i][b]Cats Away[/b][/i] is a dramatic single-player adventure with 30+ hours of thrills, laughs and adventure. Players can unlock new ships as well as customize equipment, weaponry, colors and pirate flags. Over 150 unique weapons can be equipped, from catapults and spear guns to gatling guns, torpedos and laser cannons. [/p][p][/p][p]Check out the launch trailer:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/O9rpWO5yGyM"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Introducing CATS AWAY, coming July 10!
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Get ready for Cats Away, the nautical adventure featuring adventurous girls, adorable talking cats and exciting sea battles! Cats Away brings real-time strategy to the high seas, with courageous cats facing off against plundering pirates in explosive ship-to-ship combat.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680879/6241b40d3ffa1df75db3691087ea8637d90f76d0.png"][/img][/p][p]As the game begins, three seafaring sisters embark upon a perilous maritime journey along with their faithful cat crewmates. While sailing in search of their missing father, they encounter pirate guilds, a mysterious cat-hating syndicate, ancient magic spells, giant mutated monsters and more! Help Kanna, Lilia and Alicia to navigate through dangerous waters, upgrade their ship’s armaments, recruit a crew of skilled catmates and discover their father’s biggest secret![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680879/55e741aa467acae50f0d5d072f7bcc0547ac4751.png"][/img][/p][p]In Cats Away, players manage the crew and resources of a sailing ship on an exciting and dangerous exploratory voyage. Steer the ship during combat, maneuvering into more advantageous positions and giving orders on the fly to counter enemy tactics. Between battles, dock in faraway ports-of-call to upgrade weapons and equipment, meet new friends (and enemies), learn new skills and much more. Take on side missions to earn treasure, level-up the captains and the crew and open new routes to uncharted waters![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680879/daf63315cbe5a853ce3d61748c44089d31ddaa0e.png"][/img][/p][p]Be sure to wishlist Cats Away and prepare to set sail on July 10![/p]
